MiniMax.why: Foundation-model developer whose spend scales with AI compute: H1 2026 R&D expenses rose 138.8% to US$296.9 million, mainly from cloud services expenses for model training, while Open Platform API revenue grew 703.1% on rising model-inference demand.
MiniMax.evidence: Interim results announcement 08-26-2026: 'Our research and development expenses increased by 138.8% ... mainly attributable to an increase in cloud services expenses related to training activities, driven by the increased model iteration and upgrades'.

players.product: Foundation models (MiniMax M3 language / agentic model, MiniMax H3 open-weight video generation) served through its Open Platform API (Token Plan) and AI-native products (Hailuo AI, MiniMax Code)

quarterly_data.quarter: MiniMax press release: Interim Results Announcement for the Six Months Ended June (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results: revenue rose 283.1% year-on-year from US$30.4 million to US$116.6 million, exceeding total revenue of US$79.0 million for full-year 2025; the company attributes the growth to an expanding global customer and user base and rapidly increasing demand for model inference. Gross profit rose 464.8% to US$20.8 million and gross margin increased from 12.1% to 17.9%, primarily driven by improving infrastructure efficiency. Loss for the period was US$358.0 million (US$402.2 million a year earlier); adjusted net loss (non-IFRS) was US$293.0 million (US$138.7 million).
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue US$116.6 million (+283.1% YoY); gross margin 17.9% (12.1%); loss US$358.0 million

quarterly_data.quarter: MiniMax press release: Interim Results Announcement for the Six Months Ended June (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Open Platform (model API): revenue from Open Platform and other AI-based enterprise services rose 703.1% year-on-year from US$9.2 million to US$73.9 million and made up 63.4% of total revenue (30.3% a year earlier), driven by growth in paying users and enterprise customers, higher API call volumes and rapid adoption of its Token Plan. Company: 'As demand for inference and agentic workloads continued to grow, our Open Platform served an expanded base of enterprise customers and developers and became an increasingly important driver of our business.'
quarterly_data.figure: Open Platform and other AI-based enterprise services revenue US$73.9 million (+703.1% YoY), 63.4% of revenue

quarterly_data.quarter: MiniMax press release: Interim Results Announcement for the Six Months Ended June (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: AI-native products: revenue rose 100.9% year-on-year from US$21.2 million to US$42.6 million (36.6% of revenue), driven by higher user engagement, stronger willingness to pay and continued commercialisation of Hailuo AI and other AI-native products. Revenue generated outside Chinese mainland was approximately 60.8% of total revenue; products and services were deployed in over 230 countries and regions as of June 30, 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: AI-native products revenue US$42.6 million (+100.9% YoY); approximately 60.8% of revenue from outside Chinese mainland

quarterly_data.quarter: MiniMax press release: Interim Results Announcement for the Six Months Ended June (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Compute spend: research and development expenses rose 138.8% year-on-year from US$124.3 million to US$296.9 million, mainly attributable to an increase in cloud services expenses related to training activities, driven by increased model iteration and upgrades of its foundation models and multi-modal capabilities. Cost of sales rose 258.1% to US$95.8 million, primarily in line with revenue. Property, plant and equipment stood at US$74,913 thousand at June 30, 2026 (US$1,571 thousand at December 31, 2025); the company states it had no significant capital commitments and no detailed future plans for material investments or capital assets as of June 30, 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D expenses US$296.9 million (+138.8% YoY), mainly cloud services for training

quarterly_data.signal: Models: during H1 2026 MiniMax released MiniMax M3, strengthening its capabilities in coding, agentic workflows and professional work; shortly after the period it released MiniMax H3 with open weights, advancing video generation for commercial creation. The company also offers the MiniMax Code harness product.

quarterly_data.quarter: MiniMax press release: Interim Results Announcement for the Six Months Ended June (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Outlook (company): MiniMax will stay focused on extending the performance-cost frontier, improving training and inference efficiency through full-stack co-design across models, infrastructure, systems and products; it will continue to strengthen its Open Platform, expand AI-native products and harnesses, and enhance scalable infrastructure and token throughput capacity. The company says it believes model intelligence has substantial room to advance, with coding and agentic models moving toward sustained responsibility for complex, multi-step tasks.
